# The Health & Safety Event

> > The UK's premier health and safety trade event connecting exhibitors, speakers, and professionals in occupational safety, EHS technology, and workplace protection.

The Health & Safety Event 2026 brings together industry leaders, solution providers, and safety professionals to showcase the latest innovations in personal protective equipment, EHS software, safety training, and compliance solutions. The event features exhibitors from across the UK and Europe, alongside expert speakers from organizations like NEBOSH and IOSH.

## Key Topics

- The Health & Safety Event 2026
- IOSH
- NEBOSH
- EHS software
- PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)
- Workplace safety
- Breathing apparatus
- Emergency escape equipment
- Contractor management
- Risk assessment
- Health and safety compliance
- Safety training
- Confined spaces
- Gas detection
- Safety footwear

## Keynote Speakers

- [Andy Shenstone - The Health & Safety Event 2026](https://www.healthandsafetyevent.com/speakers/andy-shenstone): Andy Shenstone, NEBOSH CEO, speaking on occupational health & safety
- [Chris Green - The Health & Safety Event 2026](https://www.healthandsafetyevent.com/speakers/chris-green): Chris Green from Keoghs speaking on health & safety law compliance
- [Derya Sousa - The Health & Safety Event 2026](https://www.healthandsafetyevent.com/speakers/derya-sousa): Derya Sousa from Kianda EHSwise presenting on EHS software & compliance

- [Benchmark Gensuite - The Health & Safety Event 2026](https://www.healthandsafetyevent.com/exhibitors/benchmark-gensuite): Benchmark Gensuite exhibitor with AI-powered EHS & sustainability platform

- [Stanley Handling Limited - The Health & Safety Event 2026](https://www.healthandsafetyevent.com/exhibitors/stanley-1): Stanley Handling exhibitor with AI safety solutions & exoskeleton tech
